thread:
kara: Quick sync: post-event automation for next Wed webinar. Goal: gated replay + benchmark one-pager attach, tag attendees by interest (benchmarks vs product demo), then route MQLs to AE queue. Who can take which piece?

diego: I can handle the gating + storage. Proposal: replay hosted on S3, signed URL valid 30 days. Use one-click email verification tool: attendee clicks "Get replay" on TY page, we send signed URL via SendGrid. That reduces scraping.

sam: I'll do the benchmark attachment and landing page. We have a short one-pager PDF with the latency/cost benchmarks. Suggest we only attach for registrants who watched >30% (attended property), otherwise show a CTA to request the report.

nora: I'll wire up the lead scoring and AE routing in HubSpot. Rule set: attended=true && company_size>=100 -> MQL; add tag: "benchmark_interest" if clicked report link. AE_pool assign if MQL.

kara: Good. Small ops notes: ensure replay has chapters (00:00 intro, 08:30 benchmark, 22:15 demo, 38:40 Q&A) and include VTT captions + transcript file link. Diego can you output VTT and transcript JSON in S3?

diego: Yes. Zoom -> cloud recording -> webhook fires -> lambda to convert to VTT + attach chapters from our TOC YAML. I'll push to S3 under marketing/webinars/2026-03-XX/. Also generate a simple HTML player page that loads captions and chapters.

sam: For the benchmark one-pager, two variants: short (1 page) for quick consumption, and expanded (4 page) with methodology. We'll gate the expanded one for attendees only. Attach the short to the replay email by default.

nora: HubSpot workflow sketch:

```
trigger: new_registration OR recording_viewed
if recording_viewed >= 30% -> set property: attended=true
if attended=true AND company_size>=100 -> set lifecycle_stage=MQL; assign owner: AE_pool
if clicked_benchmark_expanded -> add_tag: benchmark_interest
send: replay_email_with_short_pdf
```

kara: What about privacy + analytics? We should note on reg form: "We may contact you about product and benchmarks." Also preserve utm params through replay flow so we can attribute channels.

diego: We'll include utm_* as query params on signed URL and store them in Dynamo row when the signed URL is validated.

sam: Copy for replay email (short):

"Thanks for joining! Watch the replay here: [Get replay]. We've attached a short benchmark one-pager. Want the in-depth methodology? Click the link in the player to request the full report."

kara: Timeline: diego builds S3/player + signed URL flow by Tue EOD. sam publishes the two PDFs and populates chapters by Tue. nora configures HubSpot workflow + AE routing by Tue night. I'll do a quick dry-run Wed morning.

nora: Also set up a 48hr nurture: send a follow-up with product trial CTA to non-attendees, and a 24hr technical deep-dive to attendees who viewed >50%.

diego: Webhook-bot: zoom_recording_available -> posted to #marketing with recording metadata. I'll rely on that to kick lambda.

webhook-bot: event: zoom_recording_available, recording_id: rec_0a1b2c, size: 1.2GB.

kara: One last ask: ensure analytics team can grab a CSV export of viewers with watch % and utm tags. Nora can you add an export step to the workflow?

nora: Yep will add daily export to S3 and share link with analytics alias.

sam: I'll also add a small survey in the player (1-2qs) that writes back to HubSpot contact properties.

diego: Good. I'll start infra work now and post the signed URL test by EOD.

kara: Thanks team. Owners: infra/gating = diego, content + PDFs = sam, HubSpot + routing = nora. I'll own overall sequence + verify exports. Ping here when done. :rocket:
